subject: Elysian - quick GPU availability scan + soft-hold request
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Elysian - quick GPU availability scan + soft-hold request

Team —

Elysian (Ruth Chen) has signaled intent to commit to a Dedicated capacity agreement that would start in mid-November and ramp over two quarters. High level ask from them today: a) confirm we can support a fleet of ~40 colocated GPUs (preferred A100-80GB / compatible) for initial capacity, b) provide a 30-day soft-hold so they can finish procurement, and c) surface any constraints (region, SKU mix, maintenance blackout windows).

Can Ops/Capacity confirm availability across our us-west and us-east pools for 2027-Q4, and flag any competing holds in that window? If we need to convert some spare reservations into a temporary soft-hold, please advise the delta in committed GPUs and estimated monthly cost impact so I can present it to the buyer.

We should treat this as late-stage: they've completed model evals and are price-sensitive to per-token economics. If possible, provide an option for a split allocation (20 GPUs in us-west, 20 in us-east) and note any single-region risk.

Im looping Marcus for commercial sizing guidance and Aditya for kernel/sku recommendations. Thanks —

Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: capacity-estimate-2027Q4.csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elysian - quick GPU availability scan + soft-hold request

Kimberly —

Quick inventory run below (pulled against the capacity ledger as of 2027-08-03 09:55 PDT):
- us-west (primary): 56 physical A100-80GB slots free; 12 are currently assigned to short-term soft-holds that expire Sept 30 (customer-scope backups).
- us-east (secondary): 34 physical A100-80GB free; 8 on soft-hold through Oct 15.
- We also have ~24 H100-80GB nodes but they are mixed-performance and would require validation for compatibility with Elysians inference stack.

Notes / constraints:
- If Elysian needs strict single-region placement for data residency, us-west is safest but the September soft-holds reduce buffer.
- We can provide 40 GPUs split 22 us-west / 18 us-east today if we convert two short-term soft-holds (total 10 GPUs) into customer-specific provisional holds. That conversion requires Finance sign-off because it affects ability to sell those slots to opportunistic burst customers.
- ETA to convert holds: 24-48 hours once we have PO intent and an ops ticket (JIRA-OPS-7492).
- Autoscaling: recommend pre-configured burst pool for their Dedicated deployment; it preserves baseline latency SLOs while allowing short-term spikes.

If theyre sensitive to per-token unit economics, suggest the A100-80GB profile; H100 is higher perf but will increase cost and may not be necessary given their current model sizes.

Ill prepare a capacity-estimate CSV with SKU-level monthly rates and the cost delta for converting the short-term soft-holds.

—Aditya
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elysian - quick GPU availability scan + soft-hold request

Thanks Aditya — super helpful.

Kimberly, from a commercial perspective I recommend offering a 30-day soft-hold on 40 GPUs with the following guardrails:
- Soft-hold fee: 10% of monthly committed capacity (recoupable against first invoice).
- Hold expires automatically if PO not received within 30 days; well publish a final cut-off date in the mutual action plan.
- If they request region locking, tie that to a signed SLA addendum (region locking increases our operational risk and could change pricing).

Ive attached a short SoW draft to use with procurement to accelerate signature. Please note: legal needs a headcount to start the contract draft (I can fast-track once they confirm initial count).

Next steps:
1) Kimberly to confirm initial soft-hold parameters with Ruth and request procurement contact.
2) Ops (Aditya) to open JIRA-OPS-7492 and queue the conversion once we have verbal intent.
3) Marcus to provide a recommended amortized price vs usage scenario for the 12- and 24-month commitment buckets.

-Dylan
Director, Sales — Dedicated
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: ELYS-SoW-draft.pdf)

From: Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@elysian.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elysian Procurement <procurement@elysian.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elysian - quick GPU availability scan + soft-hold request

Kimberly —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the details. Were very keen to move forward; preliminary ask is 40 A100-80GB equivalents with a soft-hold while procurement finishes internal approvals. Procurement contact is listed here: Chloe Park <chloe.park@elysian.ai>.

A few clarifying items for your ops team:
- Start window: prefer Nov 15, 2027 (can be +/- 7 days).
- We will initially pin to us-west for latency with a fallback to us-east for DR/surge.
- Are there blackout windows for scheduled OS/kernel updates we should be aware of?

We can provisionally agree to the soft-hold fee you suggested; Chloe will reach out with expected PO timing.

Ruth
Head of Infrastructure
Elysian.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@elysian.ai>, Chloe Park <chloe.park@elysian.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Elysian - quick GPU availability scan + soft-hold request

Ruth/Chloe —

Appreciate the confirmation and the procurement contact, Chloe. Well proceed as follows:
- Place a 30-day soft-hold on 40 A100-equivalent GPUs (22 us-west / 18 us-east) pending PO.
- Soft-hold fee: 10% monthly (recoupable on first invoice).
- Hold start: 2027-08-04; hold expiry: 2027-09-03 23:59 PDT.

Actions completed:
- I created JIRA-OPS-7492 and tagged Aditya to process the provisional hold (Ops will confirm within 48h).
- Dylan raised Legal FYI; Marcus to follow up with tiered pricing by EOD Friday.

Chloe, please send an estimated PO date and any required commercial terms you want us to pre-populate into the SoW. If we dont receive a PO by the expiry date we release the hold automatically and notify you.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Elysian onboarded.

Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
